> [!NOTE]
> **NoSteam2Steam is a personal hobby project.**
> Feature requests are evaluated on an as-time-permits basis according to their general utility for Linux and SteamOS environments. Contributions and pull requests are always welcome.

### Motivation or Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the limitation or use case you would like addressed (e.g., "I encounter an issue when trying to...").

### Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you would like NoSteam2Steam to do.

### Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, scripts, or workarounds you have considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, references to external documentation (e.g., Proton, GBM, Steam specs), or mockups here.
